ops.title: hook-diet-nudgekey report: #315 merged, v12.88.7 released, 12.88.8 installed
ops.body:
PR https://github.com/yasyf/captain-hook/pull/315 squash-merged as 3072caf9, CI green (one CHANGELOG conflict rebased; CI re-passed on the new head).
Released: autobump tagged v12.88.7 from the merge; Release (PyPI) green. v12.88.8 followed, also green.
Installed: `capt-hook update run` put 12.88.8 under ~/.daemonkit/tools/capt-hook/. No `capt-hookd` on PATH; the daemon is `capt-hook-host`, and `capt-hook-host version` reports build 12.88.8. uv tool reinstalled pinned: capt-hook v12.88.8. Monorepo repro on 12.88.8: 27 hooks, 0 keyed on an install path (7 on 12.88.2).
Restart: believed not needed (hooks dispatch through the host daemon at 12.88.8); not tested in a live session. Each primitive's counter restarts once (old keys not migrated).
Changed: on() attributes framework-defined handlers to the first non-framework caller (same rule as hook()). Covers nudge, gate, llm_nudge/llm_gate, lint, diff_lint, styleguide, rewrite_code, set_tool_input, rewrite_command variants, permission primitives, provision, workflow. User/builtin-pack handlers keep their own file. New public keyword-only `source_file` on on(); loader.py hooks (provision_pack_resources, announce_pr_status, announce_faults) pass it and are stamped to key on loader.py.
Review-pass fixes before merge: shared decorator across modules keeps per-module keys; review-fix routing relativizes repo-local paths against the repo root (PackIndex.root; plugin_rel_path renamed root_rel_path), also fixing hook()/@on repo hooks.
Side effects: primitive-only hook dirs now appear in `capt-hook list` and the hook-lint pass (possible new lint findings).
Tests: two-install-path regression test plus shared-decorator, loader.py key, relative routing tests; failed without fix; 1796 passed locally. Astra wrote commit/PR/CHANGELOG prose.
Mechanics: task 8ec2bdf closed; OPENED/LANDED/RELEASED lines in /Users/yasyf/.claude/scratch/release-v3/inbox/deploy-go.md; worktree removed.
